architecture_policy: Preserve Operational Care as integrated operational workspace
Do not create one screen per backend module automatically
Do not invent request DTO fields
Do not alter schema unless separately proven necessary
All actor-sensitive mutations must be contract-proven
All functional tests use disposable PostgreSQL
Production remains immutable until formal cutover

accepted_design_tracks.purpose: Resolve exact routes/DTOs/state/action contracts that Phase 1 could not parse.
Trace actor identity, role authorization, anti-impersonation and fail-closed behavior before authorizing security patches.
Determine which source-proven care domains should be surfaced inside existing Operational Care rather than adding disconnected pages.
Determine source-proven audit/history capabilities suitable for supervisor visibility.

gap_decisions.reason: Controller-file actor headers are absent for many mutation endpoints, but this does not prove missing authorization. Guards, service authorization and body actor contracts must be traced first.
